message: Everyone has changed into their Spirit-Type Armament and arrived at the designated training ground.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fiiinally, I get to spar with Sensei again～」

name: Ririmu
message: 「This is my rematch from last time, you know!」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ririmu-chan, have you fought Muragaki-sensei before？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I have～ Sensei is super strong, so you better be prepared.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Seriously? I'm looking forward to it.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Enough chatter, let's begin. Who's first？」
Among the five of them, only Momiji was already radiating a tense atmosphere.

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, if you would allow me to go first.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey hey, I'm the one who's going first, aren't I!」

name: Asahi
message: 「I think it's a bit of a high hurdle for you to take the lead, Ririmu-san.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hah？ So you're saying you could handle it？」
Asahi and Ririmu glare at each other, their fighting spirit laid bare.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Well then, Muragaki-sensei, shall we start！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oi, you! Don't you dare jump the gun!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, please step back.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Scary... don't be so angry～」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「What about you, Momimomi？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm fine with being last.」
Not holding back even in a trial spar, just testing the waters first. As expected of a Suzakuin.

name: Iori
message: 「Got it. I'll decide the order then.」

name: Iori
message: 「First is Ririmu, then Asahi, third is Setsugekka, and Momiji is last.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yes! I get to go first～!」

name: Asahi
message: 「If that is what Iori-sensei wishes.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ehh, I'm third？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「That's perfectly reasonable.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Learn from Muragaki-sensei’s technique by observing the previous two students’ bouts, and make sure you have a solid countermeasure prepared before you step up, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-understood.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I’ll be watching from over there.」
Keisetsu took a step back and moved to the corner of the room.

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, you’re good with that, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I have no objections. I look forward to seeing Sensei’s skill.」
Gone was the laid-back attitude from moments ago; Momiji already had the look of a true swordsman.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, Ririmu, you’re up first. Come at me！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Okay, here I go！」
We both loosened our scabbards and swiftly drew our Origami.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I’m going a bit more serious this time, so try to keep up！」
Moving with light steps just like last time, Ririmu began to slowly circle around me.

name: Iori
message: 「Whenever you're ready, let’s see it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, yeah, here goes！」
A rising slash, scooped from below.
It was an excellent strike, carrying plenty of speed.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Still not done！」
An irregular trajectory, tracing a serpentine S-shape, bore down on me.
Normally, such unnatural movements would place a heavy strain on the body.
And since it shouldn't carry much force or speed, the benefits ought to be slim—but...

name: Iori
message: 「Good strike！」
Ririmu was managing to combine both speed and power within those irregular movements.
Unique and imaginative—that is Ririmu’s style of attack.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Aw, man, you blocked that?！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Then how about this？！」
Ririmu, who had been moving with quick, rhythmic steps until now, suddenly shifted to a style that flowed like water.

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, that’s impressive...！」
Her movements were elegant and free-flowing.
Yet, her strikes stretched out with the sharpness of a well-flexed whip.
In an instant, she had switched to a completely different battle style than before...
A swordsman’s personality always reflects in their battle style.
The bold favor an audacious style, the delicate favor a refined one; naturally, one’s method of fighting conforms to their own character.
However, it seemed Ririmu kept a repertoire of multiple combat styles within her, as if she could switch her entire personality at will.

name: Iori
message: 「Lily Style, was it? How did you manage to devise that?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heheh, the details are a secret, though!」
Her style changed once again.
This time, it shifted to movements that were linear and sharp-angled, as if she were a machine or something of the sort.

name: Ririmu
message: 「To put it simply, my worldview isn't just one thing！」
I thought a blade had come flying from directly to the side, only for the sword's trajectory to bend at a right angle.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heheh, how about that！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, you possess a rare and exceptional talent.」

name: Iori
message: 「While constantly shifting through variety, each of your styles is well-honed.」

name: Iori
message: 「To an opponent, your moves are incredibly difficult to read, and they’d likely be overwhelmed just trying to recalibrate their head after the first strike.」

name: Iori
message: 「You truly are a hallucinatory swordswoman！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Eheheh, don’t praise me so much~, you’re making me blush~！」

name: Iori
message: 「However, you also have a weakness！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ngh！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Your offense is incredibly strong, but your defense is a bit immature！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ouch… Sensei’s attacks are seriously heavy…！」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why, once your moves are read, you get pushed back one-sidedly！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Nghuuu~！」
Ririmu is an offensive-specialized fighter who confuses her opponents, draws out their anxiety and hesitation to seize the initiative, and finishes them off with one-sided pressure.
Consequently, she becomes fragile the moment she is forced onto the defensive.

name: Iori
message: 「What’s wrong? At this rate, you’ll be overwhelmed and lose！」

name: Iori
message: 「Aren’t you going to use that one from before？」
The special Tenju, Phantom, that she had shown me when we sparred before.
That must surely be Ririmu’s trump card.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh~, I didn't want to use it in front of everyone because it’s my secret weapon~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But it’ll be found out eventually anyway… guess I’ll do it！」
Putting significant distance between us, Ririmu gently strokes the blade of her Origami.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright, my stage begins now.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「—World is Mine！」
A peculiar sensation, like the ground beneath my feet turning soft.
Ririmu's illusionary assault has begun.

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm not holding back this time！！」

name: Iori
message: 「I've seen this one before, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「You should assume that anything you've shown me once won't work on me again.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What the heck, isn't Sensei way too strong？！」
Ririmu's figure splits into multiple copies.

name: Ririmu
message: 「...Wait, you're not gonna say this doesn't work because you've seen it before too, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Why don't you try it and find out？」
I flash her a crooked grin.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Y'know, Sensei, you make a real nasty face whenever we're in a match...！」
Each of the illusions steps in and charges at me！

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？！ You blocked all of 'em？！」
High from ten o'clock, aiming for the shins from three o'clock, a thrust from behind.
I manage to fend off Ririmu's relentless barrage.

name: Iori
message: 「I bet you have absolute confidence in this Tenju, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「But overconfidence clouds your eyes！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Tch... I'm not being overconfident or anything...！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Now, I wonder about that？」

name: Iori
message: 「Up until a moment ago, you were seamlessly wielding a wide variety of styles.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yet the instant you started using your special Tenju, the range of your patterns suddenly narrowed.」

name: Iori
message: 「Once an illusionist swordfighter's hand is read, it's all over, you know？」
Even if I see multiple Ririmus, they're nothing more than a trick.
There is only one real body, and only one that can actually attack.
Once I read the movements of the real body, the illusions are nothing more than a smokescreen.

name: Iori
message: 「Look, next is right here, isn't it？！」
If the opponent were just another academy student, Ririmu's illusions would surely be a massive headache.
But for me, having fought the likes of Keyou—creatures whose very survival depends on their craftiness and ability to deceive—it isn't all that difficult to deal with.

name: Iori
message: （Well, dealing with Keyou isn't exactly our regular job, though.）

The primary duty of us in the JGSDF Tenju Special Forces is to maintain Japan's defensive capabilities; dealing with Keyou is the job of the 'Spiritual Disturbance Special Task Force, <d0059>Satsuki</d>'.
However, Satsuki often gets tied up in long-term operations including investigations, and their numbers aren't exactly large.
That's why when sudden incidents occur, or when we need to suppress something through sheer numbers, dispatch requests are sent to the Tenju Special Forces.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Grrr, take this—！！」
Blades extend from Ririmu and her illusions.
A slash aimed at my throat—a flash of an illusion passes through my body.
Even knowing it's fake, it still gives me the chills.
When a bared blade is thrust at you, your body reacts reflexively. It’s what you call a defensive reflex.
Suppressing that requires a significant amount of training.
Therefore, one must never underestimate an illusion, even if it is 'only' an illusion.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Damn it, blocked again！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, you have a habit of leaning your attacks toward the upper-right when you get fired up.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... seriously！？ Do I really do that！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Don't worry about it, you can just work on fixing it from here on out.」
I re-position my Origami and cast my gaze in the direction where her real body is likely to be.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, what’s your dream for the future？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My dream is to launch my own original Jindou brand.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Current off-the-shelf Origami parts and Spirit-Type Armaments are just all about functionality, and the designs are totally lame.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, I’m gonna make my own brand with designs by me！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I want to share my world view with as many people as possible.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But hey, if some unknown, bottom-tier swordsman says they designed something, no one's gonna use it, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That’s why I’m going to become a Toujinegi.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If it’s an original brand by a Toujinegi, everyone’s gonna be interested, don’t you think？」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, that’s a great dream！」
Ririmu has a clear vision of who she wants to become at this stage. That’s a wonderful thing.
Ririmu takes a large step back.

name: Ririmu
message: 「So like, this isn't the time for me to be losing to someone like Sensei~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'd lose all face if I didn't at least land one strike on you」

name: Iori
message: 「That's the spirit. By all means, give it a try.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Okie~, then I'm going all out...！」
Ririmu's eyes glow with an eerie light.
――Suddenly, the entire visible landscape shifted.

name: Iori
message: 「Th-this is...!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What we were doing before was just playing around. This is my real power.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My Tenju, you see, it makes whatever I want to see or create take shape right before my eyes.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「This is my worldview, my very inner self.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So basically, Sensei, you've just become a part of my world.」

name: Iori
message: 「You're truly incredible, Ririmu...！」
As I breathe, I feel the cold, damp, night-chilled air in my lungs.
Taking a half-step forward, I hear the sound of a branch breaking beneath my feet.
An absolute illusion that deceives not just sight, but all five senses.
Even for a Keyou that has lived for 300 years, reproducing a dreamscape this realistic should be quite difficult.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even though I have this power, I'm not a dreamer.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm well aware of just how difficult it is to become a Toujinegi.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even so, I will become a Toujinegi.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because I believe that with this power, I can reach the top！」
A glowing butterfly flutters past my vision. I almost find myself chasing it with my eyes, but I hurriedly bring my gaze back to Ririmu.
But I realize immediately. It's useless to pay attention to such things.
Because in this space, everything appears exactly as Ririmu wishes—everything I see is a deception.
And just like that, when I noticed, Ririmu was surrounded by a swarm of glowing butterflies.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, you think this is just a hallucination, don't you？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But that's where you're wrong~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I'm going to make you realize that right now...!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I come, Sensei... Ultimate Art, 《Butterfly Effect》！！！」
Ririmu flies toward me—and then, her image blurs！
As if looking at a frame-by-frame video, Ririmu's afterimages doubled with every passing moment.
And those afterimages showed slightly different sword strokes.
The overlapping trajectories of the blades were like butterfly wings.
I retreated, but the sword strokes swelled and pursued me again as if fluttering.

name: Iori
message: （It’s okay, these are all just illusions……！！）
Without flinching at the countless blades closing in, I unleashed a strike toward Ririmu’s true form――！
But.

name: Iori
message: 「What……！？」
The countless blades, which should have been mere phantoms, tore through my Barrier Jacket.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ahahaha, I told you！ They’re not just illusions！！」

name: Iori
message: 「You’re kidding me……！」
I retreated without looking back.
It was beyond expectation that phantom attacks could actually reach my Barrier Jacket.
However, taking the hit taught me something.

name: Iori
message: 「I see, recreating phantoms is also a feat of Tenju……！」
An Origami’s cutting power is amplified many times over by coating its blade in Tenju.
In other words, Tenju can be converted into a 'cutting ability'.
Ririmu had imbued the phantom blades with this 'cutting ability'.

name: Iori
message: （I can imagine it, but making it a reality is no small feat……！）

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, come on, if you’re gonna take it slow, I’ll mince you into bits!!」
Once again, a myriad of blades closed in on me.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, your talent is worthy of praise！！」

name: Iori
message: 「But…… you still need much more training！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Kyaaaaaaaah！？」
The full-force strike I unleashed, ready for a mutual kill, slashed diagonally across Ririmu’s Barrier Jacket.
The illusory space melted away, and the original scenery returned. Ririmu’s Tenju must have run out.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ouchie…… ugh, I lost~」
I reached out a hand to the collapsed Ririmu and helped her up.

name: Iori
message: 「Are you alright？ Are you hurt？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, I’m fine」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, Sensei, your strategy of aiming for a mutual hit is seriously rough, you know!」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, well, now you know. That right there is your weakness, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「Because you allocate your power into your unique Tenju, you inevitably fall short compared to an ordinary swordsman in terms of attack power and defense.」

name: Iori
message: 「That’s why you get overpowered when a power-fighter who’s dumped all their points into attack Tenju rushes you, prepared to trade blows.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, yeah, that's true.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're tough, your attacks are heavy, and that single hit is way too strong, so it's seriously a pain, Sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「From now on, it’s going to be really tough for you if you get pushed back by someone of Victoria's type.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... Sensei, what should I do？」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s okay. I’ll come up with a practice routine so you can overcome this by next time.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「For real？ Seriously, countin' on ya！」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, leave it to me！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, then that’s it for you, Ririmu.」
